{
  "findings": [
    {
      "location": "html, opening paragraph",
      "severity": "minor",
      "source_quote": "This is the first ... continuing to call men and women ... drawn to follow Jesus.",
      "suggested_fix": "Tumia “Hii ni makala ya kwanza”; badili “anaendelea kuitisha wanaume na wanawake wajibu wa kujibu” kuwa “anaendelea kuwaita wanaume na wanawake kuitikia”, na “ukiwakaribishwa” kuwa “ukivutwa”.",
      "translation_quote": "Huu ni makala ya kwanza ... anaendelea kuitisha wanaume na wanawake wajibu wa kujibu ... ukiwakaribishwa kumfuata Yesu."
    },
    {
      "location": "html, paragraph beginning “Unaweza kujisikia”",
      "severity": "minor",
      "source_quote": "You may experience both exhilaration and apprehension.",
      "suggested_fix": "Badili sentensi kuwa “Unaweza kuhisi msisimko na pia wasiwasi.”",
      "translation_quote": "Unaweza kujisikia kwa msisimko pamoja na wasiwasi."
    },
    {
      "location": "html, paragraph beginning “Kuna utupu”",
      "severity": "major",
      "source_quote": "an emptiness ... only Jesus can fill ... resonates with those heart longings ... we find ourselves being transformed.",
      "suggested_fix": "Badili “kuufunika” kuwa “kuujaza”; tumia “Kuna usafi na uzuri katika maisha ya Yesu unaoendana na shauku hizo za mioyo. Tunapotembea na Yesu, tunajikuta tukibadilishwa.”",
      "translation_quote": "kuufunika ... yanayolingana na kutamani kwa mioyo hiyo ... tunakutana tukigeuzwa."
    },
    {
      "location": "html, paragraph beginning “Ukitushirikisha”",
      "severity": "major",
      "source_quote": "If you join us on this journey",
      "suggested_fix": "Badili “Ukitushirikisha katika safari hii” kuwa “Ukijiunga nasi katika safari hii”.",
      "translation_quote": "Ukitushirikisha katika safari hii"
    },
    {
      "location": "html, Matthew 4:18-22 blockquote",
      "severity": "major",
      "source_quote": "Follow me ... fishers of men. And they straightway left their nets",
      "suggested_fix": "Badili “Nifuate” kuwa “Nifuateni”, “wawindaji samaki” kuwa “wavuvi”, na “wawindaji wa watu” kuwa “wavuvi wa watu”. Badili “Wakakata wavu wao mara moja” kuwa “Mara wakaziacha nyavu zao”.",
      "translation_quote": "Nifuate ... wawindaji samaki ... wawindaji wa watu. Wakakata wavu wao mara moja"
    },
    {
      "location": "html, paragraph beginning “Fikiria mwenyewe”",
      "severity": "major",
      "source_quote": "The sun was rising ... Fishing has been your life. You are as much at home on the sea as you are in your cottage.",
      "suggested_fix": "Tumia “Jua lilikuwa likichomoza kwenye upeo wa mashariki”; badili “kuwindia samaki” kuwa “kuvua samaki”, na sentensi mbili za mwisho kuwa “Uvuvi umekuwa maisha yako. Unajisikia umetulia baharini kama ulivyo nyumbani katika kibanda chako.”",
      "translation_quote": "Jua lilikuwa likinyoshwa ... kuwindia samaki ... Uwindaji umekuwa maisha yako. Umerahisi kama nyumbani baharini"
    },
    {
      "location": "html, paragraph beginning “Siku nyingine”",
      "severity": "minor",
      "source_quote": "keep the creditors at bay ... Your father was a fisherman. Your grandfather was a fisherman.",
      "suggested_fix": "Tumia “kuwazuia wadai wasikusumbue kwa wiki nyingine”, na badili “mwindaji samaki” katika sentensi zote mbili kuwa “mvuvi”.",
      "translation_quote": "kumuweka mbali mkopeshaji ... Baba yako alikuwa mwindaji samaki. Babu yako alikuwa mwindaji samaki."
    },
    {
      "location": "html, paragraph beginning “Kila asubuhi”",
      "severity": "major",
      "source_quote": "This morning ... a man approaches ... the local rabbi",
      "suggested_fix": "Badili “Kila asubuhi” kuwa “Asubuhi hii”, “mtu mmoja akaruka karibu” kuwa “mtu mmoja anakaribia”, na “myezi wa mahubiri wa mahali” kuwa “rabi wa eneo hilo”.",
      "translation_quote": "Kila asubuhi ... mtu mmoja akaruka karibu ... myezi wa mahubiri wa mahali"
    },
    {
      "location": "html, paragraph beginning “Yakobo anamwangalia”",
      "severity": "major",

      "severity": "major",
      "source_quote": "Follow me, and I will make you fishers of men ... tethered to a stump by the shore",
      "suggested_fix": "Tumia “Nifuateni, nami nitawafanya kuwa wavuvi wa watu.” Badili “Waliwachia” kuwa “Waliacha”, na “kwenye kiti” kuwa “kwenye kisiki”. Mwishoni tumia “Labda ilikuwa shauku kubwa mioyoni mwa wanafunzi hawa—‘tumaini’ ambalo kumfuata Yesu kungeweza kulitimiza.”",
      "translation_quote": "Nifuate ... wawindaji wa watu ... Waliwachia ... kwenye kiti ... “tumaini” kwamba kumfuata Yesu kunaweza kutimiza."
    },
    {
      "location": "html, paragraph beginning “Mizazi ya wanaume Wayahudi”",
      "severity": "major",
      "source_quote": "break the Roman yoke ... the most promising revolutionary prospect of the day ... they would never be the same.",
      "suggested_fix": "Badili “angenyanyasa ufunuo wa Kirumi” kuwa “angevunja nira ya utawala wa Kirumi”; tumia “Yesu ndiye aliyeonekana kuwa na matumaini makubwa zaidi ya kuleta mapinduzi wakati huo.” Badili “hawakuwa watoe sawa tena” kuwa “wasingebaki vile walivyokuwa tena”.",
      "translation_quote": "angenyanyasa ufunuo wa Kirumi ... Yesu alikuwa tegemeo la msukumo la siku hizo ... hawakuwa watoe sawa tena."
    },
    {

      "severity": "minor",
      "source_quote": "the familiar, secure life of the fisherman ... an adventure",
      "suggested_fix": "Badili “maisha ya kawaida, yenye usalama ya muwindaji” kuwa “maisha waliyozoea, yenye usalama, ya mvuvi”, na “msimu wa kusisimua” kuwa “safari yenye matukio ya kusisimua”.",
      "translation_quote": "maisha ya kawaida, yenye usalama ya muwindaji ... msimu wa kusisimua"
    },
    {
      "location": "html, paragraph beginning “Baada ya msalaba”",
      "severity": "major",
      "source_quote": "they could not resist the allure of the familiar ... He told them to cast on the right side of the ship.",

      "translation_quote": "huwezi kukwepa mvuto wa yaliyo ya kawaida ... Akawaambia wawatupie upande wa kulia wa mashua."
    },
    {
      "location": "html, John 21:3-6 blockquote",
      "severity": "major",
      "source_quote": "They went forth ... Cast the net ... they were not able to draw it",
      "suggested_fix": "Badili “Wakamtoka” kuwa “Wakatoka”, “Mwatupie wavu” kuwa “Tupeni wavu”, na “hawakuweza kuvuza” kuwa “hawakuweza kuuvuta”.",
      "translation_quote": "Wakamtoka ... Mwatupie wavu ... hawakuweza kuvuza"

      "translation_quote": "Unapomamua ... utegemezi wake kamili ... hautaweza tena kumtumaini wewe mwenyewe ... hakuna kitu kizuri chaanayeishi ... kutaka kunikuwapo"
    },
    {
      "location": "html, paragraph beginning “Ufuasi utatupeleka”",
      "severity": "major",
      "source_quote": "could not have fathomed ... We commit the details to our Master.",
      "suggested_fix": "Tumia “Kama vile wanafunzi wasingeweza kufahamu kumfuata Yesu kungewapeleka wapi, sisi pia hatuwezi.” Badili sentensi ya mwisho kuwa “Tunamkabidhi Bwana wetu mambo yote ya safari hiyo.”",
      "translation_quote": "hawangeweza kubahatisha ... Tunamipa Bwana wetu maelezo da details."
    },
    {
      "location": "html, Luke 9:62 quotation",
      "severity": "major",
      "source_quote": "having put his hand to the plough, and looking back",
      "suggested_fix": "Badili “kwenye plagi, akimtazama nyuma” kuwa “kwenye jembe la kukokotwa, akitazama nyuma”.",
      "translation_quote": "kwenye plagi, akimtazama nyuma"
    },
    {
      "location": "html, paragraph beginning “Wakati Yesu alionekana”",
      "severity": "major",
      "source_quote": "the weary disciples ... How gently piercing are the words of Jesus.",
      "suggested_fix": "Badili “wanafunzi waliochelemea” kuwa “wanafunzi waliochoka”; badili sentensi ya mwisho kuwa “Maneno ya Yesu yanapenya moyoni kwa upole ulioje!”",
      "translation_quote": "wanafunzi waliochelemea ... Maneno ya Yesu yalikuwa na pemba laini yanayokata kwa undani."

    {
      "location": "html, paragraph beginning “Petro alijibu”",
      "severity": "major",
      "source_quote": "Feed my lambs.",

      "translation_quote": "Lisha ndugu zangu."

    {
      "location": "html, paragraph beginning “Petro hatimaye”",
      "severity": "major",
      "source_quote": "Now Jesus is asking him to reciprocate that love.",

      "severity": "major",

      "translation_quote": "akihojiwa kwa uongo, na kukamatwa mate ... aliyeendelea kumtaka kwamba ... “Sijui.” ... Yesu amenihukumu upendo wake."

      "translation_quote": "Akilazwa kwa maumivu ya moyo Petro aliliita ... kumfanana naye."
    },
    {
      "location": "html, paragraph beginning “Yesu anakulizia”",
      "severity": "major",
      "source_quote": "Defer to your brother",
      "suggested_fix": "Badili “Msubiri ndugu yako” kuwa “Mtangulize ndugu yako”.",
      "translation_quote": "Msubiri ndugu yako"

    {
      "location": "html, paragraph beginning “Ikiwa moyoni mwako”",
      "severity": "major",

      "translation_quote": "Yesu hatumwiti bila kutubariki kwa vifaa, na hatusiagi hadi atakapothibitisha kwamba tuko tayari ... Petro aliiitwa ... alipewa neema."
    },
    {
      "location": "html, paragraph beginning “Ningependa kuvutia”",
      "severity": "minor",
      "source_quote": "another attribute of discipleship that is sometimes misplaced",
      "suggested_fix": "Badili “ambayo wakati mwingine hupangwa vibaya” kuwa “ambayo wakati mwingine haieleweki ipasavyo”.",
      "translation_quote": "sifa nyingine ya ufuasi ambayo wakati mwingine hupangwa vibaya"

    {
      "location": "html, paragraph beginning “Swali kali”",
      "severity": "major",
      "source_quote": "your devoted love for Me",
      "suggested_fix": "Badili “upendo wako uliotawanywa kwangu” kuwa “upendo wako wa dhati uliojitoa kwangu”.",
      "translation_quote": "upendo wako uliotawanywa kwangu"

      "location": "html, paragraph beginning “Tunaweza kufahamu”",
      "severity": "minor",
      "source_quote": "it is not considered toil ... No sacrifice ... is a loss.",
      "suggested_fix": "Tumia “kufanya kazi kwa ajili yake hakuonekani kuwa taabu” na “Hakuna kujitolea tunakofanya kwa ajili ya ufalme wa mbinguni ambako ni hasara.”",
      "translation_quote": "haitachukuliwi kuwa bidii ... Hakuna kujitolea tunaofanya kwa ajili ya ufalme wa mbinguni ni hasara."
    },
    {
      "location": "html, final paragraph",
      "severity": "major",
      "source_quote": "they run counter to our human impulses",
      "suggested_fix": "Badili “yanapakana na hamu zetu za kibinadamu” kuwa “yanapingana na misukumo yetu ya kibinadamu”.",
      "translation_quote": "yanapakana na hamu zetu za kibinadamu"

    {

      "severity": "minor",

      "translation_quote": "Mashua ya mbao iliyochakaa ikielea kwenye maji tulivu"
